items.title: Fresh 10-year decommissioning licence issued for Kozloduy 3 and 4
items.summary: Bulgaria's Nuclear Regulatory Agency has granted a 10-year licence to the State Enterprise Radioactive Waste for decommissioning work on the shutdown units 3 and 4 at the Kozloduy Nuclear Power Plant.

items.title: Westinghouse and Amentum sign AP1000/AP300 collaboration agreements
items.summary: A series of agreements between Westinghouse Electric Company and Amentum aims to support the fleet-scale deployment of the AP1000 reactor and to collaborate on gaining regulatory approval of the AP300 small modular reactor.

items.title: Finnish regulator gives positive decision on used fuel repository
items.summary: The safety requirements for granting the operating licence for the world's first used nuclear fuel repository have been met, Finland's Radiation and Nuclear Safety Authority has said in an official statement to the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Employment.
